description: Read the public Solana wallet leaderboard ranked by net SOL over a recent 15-day window. wallets holds wallets slow enough to follow; fast_wallets lists bots that close trades within seconds. Past performance is not a prediction. Each row carries headline_pnl_sol (net SOL cash flow, open positions at cost) and a verdict {decision: pass|caution|skip, reasons}; read the reasons before copying any wallet.
name: get_top_wallets
